quotes.text: The Lord God of Israel hath sent his angel with this message to the children of men; “to them that dwell upon the earth, and to every nation, and kindred, and tongue, and people, saying, with a loud voice, fear God and give glory to him: for the hour of his judgments is I come, and worship him that

thersoever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that are in the earth. “Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; ne
